history.sg_progress: Implementation was carried out in a phased manner and delays were experienced due to resource constraints. The Office of Information and Communications Technology has integrated regular briefings on ICT security and incidents into meetings of the ICT Steering Committee and reestablished the Information Security Board in 2025, which is actively fulfilling its mandate, with two quarterly meetings held as of August 2025. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
